newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA APPOINTS NUMBERING AGENCY FOR SECURITIES.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA APPOINTS NUMBERING AGENCY FOR SECURITIES.

text.p: Romanian capital market regulator CNVM said on Friday it had appointed the clearing, settlement and depository house (SNCDD) as national securities numbering agency to put trading in line with world standards.

The SNCDD will start issuing international securities identification numbers (ISINs) as soon as it wins membership of the Association of National Numbering Agencies (ANNA) at a meeting in Frankfurt in October, a CNVM statement said.

It said the SNCDD would be the only institution to assign ISIN codes to all securities, including shares, bonds and treasury bills, in line with International Standards Organisation norms on classification of financial instruments.
The ISIN code, a universal code for identifying securities, is made up of six numbers and letters to be used in trading and managing securities by local and foreign investors.
"We have already started assigning ISINs, now we need international recognition," SNCDD manager Dragos Neacsu said. "We have applied to ANNA to gain this recognition."

He said introduction of ISINs in Romania would facilitate market transactions by foreign investors. "Foreigners are accustomed to having such codes to recognise securities and we will have them as soon as ANNA accepts us as a member."
